title: SettlementVerdict
description: Schema for the LLM verdict returned by the leader validator inside settle_claim(). Validators compare this structure for Comparative Equivalence Principle consensus.

approved.description: Whether the insurance claim is approved. MUST match the programmatic check (canonical_delay_minutes >= threshold). LLM must not override this.

canonical_delay_minutes.description: The canonical arrival delay in minutes used for the payout decision. Arrival delay is preferred; falls back to departure delay when arrival data is absent.

reasoning.description: Plain-English explanation of the verdict for the claimant. 1-2 sentences. Must reference the measured delay and the threshold.

flight_status.description: Current operational status of the flight as returned by AviationStack.

edge_case_detected.description: Description of any edge case affecting the verdict (e.g. 'flight cancelled — not a delay claim', 'flight diverted — arrival delay measured to diversion airport'). Use 'none' if no edge case applies.
examples: flight cancelled — not a delay claim, refund process applies
flight diverted — delay measured to alternate destination
claim submitted before flight landed — premature
